T0535.title: SLSA
T0535.definition: Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts, a framework for improving build provenance and supply-chain integrity.
T0535.description: SLSA provides a maturity framework for making software builds traceable, verifiable, and harder to tamper with. It helps organize source control, build isolation, dependency governance, provenance, and release policy into staged goals. Adoption should be tied to business risk and target levels, not treated only as a compliance label.
T0535.usageExample: Assess SLSA related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
